scope: Assets only. No engine import, input, persistence, audio/haptics or runtime screenshot pass claimed.

toggle_mapping.enabled_true: sound_toggle_on / music_toggle_on / vibration_toggle_on at respective source XYWH
toggle_mapping.enabled_false: toggle_off at each row toggle position, source canvas 255x145

state_rules: Use a single full toggle sprite, not separate reconstructed knob/check for normal.
All six canonical states share exactly the sound normal alpha. Other rows share 255x145 nominal dimensions and row-local source centers.
Pointer down chooses pressed texture; pointer cancel/out restores current value; pointer up changes exactly one bound setting.
Disabled retains stored value and rejects pointer/keyboard changes; never just substitute ON for unavailable OFF.
Sound/music/haptics reflect current persistent settings on every opening. Haptics unavailable uses disabled value-preserving state.

close.action: Dismiss this panel, retain settings and previous gameplay state.

language.must: Live one-layer value only. QA dynamic_language_value_reference_only.png and language_original_reference_only.png must never ship as invariant UI or be overlaid by another value.

guide.row_action: Open actual approved Guide flow, preserve settings and navigation state.

shadows.title: title_shadow at z49
shadows.rule: Render before corresponding control; never duplicate with additional CSS shadow. Original composite rows already include source shadow; do not add duplicate component shadows.

responsive: Use one uniform panel scale; no independently distorted glyph/icon/toggle aspect ratios.
915x1719 source canvas. Frame outer core roughly x48..866,y278..1507. Preserve title/close overlap.
At 320 CSSpx viewport, close nominal150px and toggle255px remain >=44px with normal width-fit panel; verify short viewport/scroll/safe-area explicitly.
Keep at least44 CSSpx interactive hit targets even if displayed artwork smaller; invisible target expansion must not collide.
pending_runtime_acceptance: Exact 1:1 source comparison at target runtime capture sizes
Chinese and English 320x480/other required screens readable and unclipped
Five row bindings and state persistence
Pressed/disabled state appearance and input block
